Stage 1920x1080, origin top-left. There is NO camera move and no cam variable: the world scrolls past at SPEED = 9 px per frame (line 1444), i.e. scroll = frame * 9, and every scrolling layer is translate(wrap(scroll * factor, tile) + rep * tile, 0) with wrap(v,t) = -(((v % t) + t) % t) (line 1453). SCREEN x = local x + that translate; y is never shifted. The ground line of the whole scene is ROAD_Y = 856 (the top edge of the asphalt); both city tiers stand on it. All boxes below are SCREEN px at frame 150, computed by running the unchanged files in Node with a fake window (hero-flag.js sets JX_CLEAN_HERO = true, hero-port-a.js gives JRMAP, which scene 03 does not use) and walking the returned {t,a,c} tree with transform composition, then confirmed against Chromium renders of the same moments (0 console errors). The tree has 1195 virtual nodes; the scene function costs about 0.39 ms/frame in Node with its memo caches warm (CityBuilding _cbMemo, GantryBack/GantryFront _gbMemo/_gfMemo). 119 attributes change every frame (nothing is still): sun glow r, 3+3 bird transforms and 6 wing paths, 3 cloud transforms (+1 cloud opacity while it fades in), the 2 far-tier and 2 mid-tier translates, the jet translate, the lane dash-offset, 36 road-dot cx, the 2 pole translates, 4 gantry translates, 4 truck translates + 4 body bob/pitch transforms + 8 exhaust circles + 12 wheel rotations, and 2 fence translates. PLAYER FACTS (hero-glue.js / viewer/timeline.js): scene 03 occupies 14600-21800 ms of the site clock. Its entrance is master frames 391->475 played at ENTER_RATE 1.2 (36 frames/s, 2333 ms), and renderMaster only starts drawing sceneTransit at master 420, so for the first ~806 ms of 'scene 03' (14600-15406 ms) the picture is still sceneWorld (scene 02 at the warehouse); sceneTransit then CROSSFADES in over master 420-438 with opacity smoothstep((m-420)/18) and is alone from about 15906 ms. Transit frame = (ms - 14600) * 0.036 - 29 during the entrance, then 55 + (ms - 16933.3)/1000*30 during the idle (hero-glue STOPS[2]: eFrom 391, eTo 475, iStart 55, sec false, i.e. a FRAME clock, not an ambient-seconds clock). So the scene only ever shows transit frames 0 -> about 201; frame 150 = 20100 ms on the site clock. Desktop crop centre FOCUS_X[2] and the phone camera blend are player camera, not scene art. SCROLL RATES (at 30 fps): far city tier 0.18 -> 48.6 px/s; mid city tier 0.42 -> 113.4 px/s; road markings, light poles, gantries and the trucks' world position 1.0 -> 270 px/s; foreground fence 1.25 -> 337.5 px/s; sky, sun, clouds, birds, jet, hill and Fuji do not scroll at all (they only have their own ambient drift). elements.look: A small airliner in level flight with two white speed-line dashes trailing behind it. Construction (local units, nose to the right): far-side wing peeking above the fuselage (#c7d4e8); swept tailplane; a big swept navy fin anchored at the tail; a white fuselage with a round nose and an up-swept tapered tail cone (stroke rgba(22,41,63,0.4) 1.5); a navy lower hull; a dark cockpit windshield; 12 porthole rects 4.6 x 5.2 at x -50 + 9.2i, y -42.5; two pale doors at x 60 and -38; the near wing swept down-back (white with a navy leading wedge); an engine nacelle slung ahead of the wing with a teal intake ring and a dark exhaust; landing gear and a fin-tip beacon that are both invisible here (see disabledOrHidden). CRITICAL: at the scene's scroll rate the jet never reaches the frame. px runs from -360 at frame 0 to -105.4 at frame 201 (the last frame the site ever shows), so its right-most point is still at x -73. It only crosses x = 0 at about frame 259 (8.65 s of scene time) - the site's dwell is 7.2 s and the idle clock stops at frame ~201. The jet is therefore drawn 1 group x 25 nodes every frame and is NEVER SEEN in normal playback; it appears only if the scene is held open (autoplay off, or a long manual stop).

ambientMotion.what: The whole world scrolls right-to-left (the only 'camera' in the scene)
ambientMotion.formula: scroll = frame * SPEED, SPEED = 9 px/frame = 270 px/s. Layer translate = wrap(scroll * f, tile) + rep * tile with wrap(v,t) = -(((v % t) + t) % t). f = 0.18 (far tier, tile 7000, 48.6 px/s), 0.42 (mid tier, tile 7000, 113.4 px/s), 1.0 (light poles tile 5400, gantries tile 2700 with phase scroll + 2030, lane dash offset, road dots), 1.25 (foreground fence, tile 7000, 337.5 px/s). Two copies (rep 0 and 1) of every tiled layer are always drawn, so the wrap is seamless. The trucks do not move in screen x - the camera rides with them.

rot = ((distance / scale) / 11) * 180/pi degrees with distance = scroll, applied to the 5-spoke group only (the tyre and rim are circles). For scale 1.8 that is 26.05 degrees per frame. The spokes are 72 degrees apart, so 26.05 deg/frame strobes badly against the 5-fold symmetry (2.76 frames per spoke) - the wheels read as juddering or turning the wrong way. All four trucks spin at slightly different rates because the rate depends on their scale (26.05, 24.93, 26.05, 27.26 deg/frame).

ambientMotion.what: Truck body bob (vertical, body only - wheels and shadows stay put)
ambientMotion.formula: bob = sin((frame - lag) * 0.9) * 1.5 local units, lags 0, 8, 16, 24 for trucks 1-4. Period 2 pi / 0.9 = 6.98 FRAMES (0.233 s) - a fast 1.5-unit jiggle, not a slow breath; on screen it is +-2.6 to +-2.8 px. The four lags put the trucks out of phase with each other. Values at frame 150: 0.13, 1.27, 1.41, 0.45 local (0.24, 2.38, 2.54, 0.77 px).

ambientMotion.what: Truck lateral drift (the convoy breathing in and out of formation)
ambientMotion.formula: drift = sin(time * 0.5 + i * 1.4) * 12 px, period 4 pi = 12.57 s, 1.4 rad apart per truck. At frame 150: +7.18, -8.25, -9.99, +4.86. It is added to the truck's x AND is inside the posAt() used for the pitch, so it also produces a permanent micro-pitch of about +-0.002 degrees.

truckMotion(posAt, frame): the second difference of posAt convolved with a 40-tap damped-spring impulse response (w 0.3, z 0.45), then pitch = 1.6 tanh(-0.06 acc / 1.6), applied as rotate(pitch, 92, 80) - positive = nose down. During the hold it is essentially zero (|pitch| <= 0.002 deg); it only matters in the entrance (see choreography).

kk = ((scroll + off) mod 90)/90 for off = 0 and 45; circle at local (118 - 16kk, 70 - 26kk), r = 2 + 4.5kk, opacity (1 - kk) * 0.7 * run with run = 1. Cycle 90 px = 10 frames = 0.333 s, two puffs half a cycle apart, on all four trucks in lockstep (they share the same distance = scroll).

ambientMotion.what: Lane dashes and road dots scroll
ambientMotion.formula: strokeDashoffset = scroll % 58 (one dash period every 58 px = 6.44 frames); road dots cx = i*58 + 29 - (scroll % 58). Both move left at 270 px/s. The dots are phase-locked to the middle of each dash and therefore invisible.

wx = ((9 * time * 4 + i * 760) mod 2420) - 250, i.e. 36 px/s for all three, loop 2420 px = 67.2 s, the three evenly spaced 760 px apart. Edge fade: ed = min((wx + 250)/210, (2170 - wx)/210, 1), so a wrapped cloud reappears at x -250 and fades in over its first 210 px (5.8 s). Group opacity = 0.92 * 0.96 * ed = up to 0.8832. NOTE the direction: the ground scrolls left (the trucks drive right) but the clouds move right, so the sky travels the wrong way relative to the parallax.

ambientMotion.what: Birds drift RIGHT, bob and flap
ambientMotion.formula: x = ((rx * span + time * (14 + rs*10)) mod (span + 280)) - 140, with span 2200 (flock A) and 2100 (flock B); speeds 20.91, 19.81, 23.30 px/s; loops 118.6 / 125.2 / 106.4 s (A) and 113.8 / 120.1 / 102.1 s (B). y = yBase + ry*190 + 9 sin(0.7 time + 2.2 i), +-9 px with period 8.98 s; yBase 150 (A) and 105 (B). Wing flap: arc control y = -3.2 - 3.4 sin(7 time + 1.9 i), period 0.90 s. Scales 1.196, 1.141, 1.315. Same direction problem as the clouds - they drift with the trucks instead of against them.

glow radius = 46*4.6 + (0.5 + 0.5 sin(0.55 time)) * 46*0.15 = 211.6 .. 218.5 px, period 11.42 s (216.37 at frame 150). The halo, disc and ring are static. The 12-ray path is computed from time but returned as null.

px = ((time * 38) mod 2640) - 360 (38 px/s, loop 69.47 s); vertical bob pb = 5 sin(0.85 time), period 7.39 s, around y 148. Group opacity 0.92. Never on screen during the site's playback - see the jet element.

Diffing transit(150) against transit(151) changes 119 attributes: the sun glow r; 6 bird transforms and 6 wing paths; 3 cloud transforms plus cloud #0's opacity while it fades in; the 4 city-tier translates; the jet translate; the lane dash offset; 36 road-dot cx; 2 pole translates; 4 gantry translates; 4 truck group translates, 4 body bob/pitch transforms, 8 exhaust circles (cx, cy, r, opacity each) and 12 wheel rotations; 2 fence translates. Only the sky divs, the haze rects, the road/shoulder/guardrail rects, the top edge line and the vignette never change.

choreography.what: sceneTransit is NOT drawn yet. renderMaster only adds the transit layer from master 420, so the first ~806 ms of 'scene 03' on the site clock is still sceneWorld - scene 02's warehouse at camera 1900, with trucks 2 and 3 departing (T_WORLD.departs2). Anyone judging scene 03's opening has to know its picture starts late.

The transit scene CROSSFADES in over the world: the master timeline wraps it in a layer with opacity = s*s*(3 - 2s), s = (master - 420)/18. It is called a 'slide' in the source comments but nothing moves - both pictures are drawn in place and one fades up over the other. The world layer stops being drawn at master 438.

The convoy eases into formation. Each truck's x = base - (1 - convoyIn) * 560 + drift, convoyIn = easeOutCubic(frame/70), so all four start 560 px to the left of their final places and slide right together, decelerating the whole way. Truck 1's rear x by frame: 0 -> -440, 10 -> -230.7, 20 -> -84.1, 30 -> 21.3, 40 -> 83.3, 50 -> 115.8, 55 -> 124.0, 60 -> 128.5, 70 -> 120+drift. Group opacity = min(1, convoyIn * 1.5), so they fade up from 0 at frame 0 to fully opaque at frame 22. Pitch (nose-down under braking, all four within 0.003 deg of each other because they share one motion curve): 0.07 at f 2, 0.34 at f 6, peak 0.478 at f 10, 0.45 at f 14, 0.31 at f 22, 0.25 at f 35, 0.18 at f 45, 0.12 at f 55, 0.02 at f 70, then 0. Note the convoy arrives from the LEFT while the road scrolls left - they are slower than the road for the first 70 frames, then match it.

choreography.frames: transit 0-55 (the whole entrance, played at 36 frames/s)
choreography.what: Everything else is already running at full speed from frame 0: the road, poles, gantries and fence scroll, the wheels spin, the exhaust cycles, the clouds and birds drift. The gantry portal starts half off the left edge (far leg at x -630, its near leg at x 548 at frame 0) and slides out; by frame 55 only its near leg (x 53-89) and the right tip of its beam are left, and the NEXT portal's far leg has just entered at x 1575. Cloud #0 is at wx -250 at frame 0 (opacity 0, just wrapped) and fades in through the entrance; only two clouds are visible at the start.

The player switches from the entrance to the idle, which keeps running a FRAME clock from 55 (hero-glue STOPS[2], sec: false). Nothing changes at the seam - the idle is the same function of the same frame number, so the scroll, the convoy settle and all the ambient motion continue without a jump.

No choreography left - only the scroll and the ambient motion. Over these 146 frames the world moves 1314 px: the gantry portal re-enters from the right at frame 80 (far leg x 1350) and walks left to x 261 by frame 201, so the viewer sees exactly one portal cross most of the frame; the light poles pass three at a time (x 205/905/1605 at f 55, 50/750/1450 at f 150, 291/991/1691 at f 201); the fence posts pass at 2.2 a second; the far tier moves only 236 px and the mid tier 552 px in the whole hold. Frame 150 (20100 ms) is representative of the middle of this hold.

One full gantry portal fills the right two thirds of the frame (far leg 720-746, beam 706-1940, big sign 840-1400, exit sign 1440-1770, near leg 1898-1934); the four trucks sit at x 127, 612, 1110, 1605; three clouds and five birds are in the sky; the sun is clear in the top-right; Fuji's crown fills the upper left between x 216 and 705; the jet is 138 px off the left edge.

The site's dwell for scene 03 is 7200 ms, so the idle stops at about frame 201 and the glue crossfades to scene 04: opacity 1 for two frames (33 ms), then 0.85 s on cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1), with 03's last frame frozen above the entering map. Nothing in sceneTransit plays an exit.

The jet plane: drawn as about 25 nodes every frame but OFF SCREEN LEFT for the whole of the site's playback. px runs -360 (frame 0) to -105.4 (frame 201, the last frame the player reaches) and its right-most point only crosses x = 0 at about frame 259 (8.65 s).
